sources.quote: HD 175541 is an 8th magnitude star with an exoplanetary companion in the constellation Serpens.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.3 solar radii and 1.77 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,200 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
